description: Authenticates a customer's domain for outbound email sending via Brevo (SPF/DKIM/DMARC-related records), so the customer does not need to manually copy/paste DNS records.
variableDescription: dkim1_value and dkim2_value are per-domain DKIM CNAME targets, brevo_code_value is a per-account verification TXT value, and dmarc_value is the DMARC policy TXT value — all generated by Brevo per customer domain at authentication-setup time.
